description: This file defines Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes for handling note data in a notes application, including classes for creating, updating, and representing notes, along with a static mapping class to convert from Note model to DTO.

classes.name: CreateNoteDto
classes.description: DTO used to create a new note with required title and optional content.

classes.name: UpdateNoteDto
classes.description: DTO used to update an existing note with required title and optional content.

classes.name: NoteDto
classes.description: DTO representing a note returned to clients, including metadata and content.

classes.name: NoteMapping
classes.description: Static class providing extension method to map Note model to NoteDto.

methods.name: ToDto
methods.description: Extension method converting Note object to NoteDto.
